label.rationale: Whole figure (no printed label for every region). Timeline headed Patient 1: Printed arrow timeline for p1 (stroke, PSG at 2 months, PFO closure, CPAP at 4 months, no recurrence at 24 months). Schematic of already-annotated events, not a primary record. No burned-in identifiers; only relative months. Timeline headed Patient 2: Printed arrow timeline for p2 (stroke, PFO closure at 4 months, home sleep test/CPAP, follow-up at 6 months, no recurrence 24 months). Schematic of already-annotated events. No burned-in identifiers; only relative months. Timeline headed Patient 3: Printed arrow timeline for p3 (stroke, PSG at 4 months, CPAP, follow-up at 6 months, no recurrence 15 years). Schematic of already-annotated events. No burned-in identifiers; only relative months/years. Timeline headed Patient 4: Printed arrow timeline for p4 (stroke, PSG at 2 months, CPAP at 4 months, no recurrence at 12 months). Schematic of already-annotated events. No burned-in identifiers; only relative months. Bottom unlabelled polysomnography strip (caption: p4): Screenshot of a multichannel polysomnography epoch strip (EEG, EOG, chin EMG, EKG, HR, leg EMG, airflow, effort, SaO2) for patient p4 with red arousal, obstructive apnea and desaturation event boxes and grey epoch stamps (N1/N2, Supine, #866-#868). Zoomed to inspect: no patient name, MRN, DOB or study date burned in; only channel labels, event annotations and epoch numbers. Patient-attributed waveform suited to an EHR sleep-study record.
